feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 July 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 29 July 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic and low pressure near Norway as a weakening frontal zone continues to clear the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the east at first, veering west or northwest 2 to 4 later this evening, backing west 3 or 4 overnight, occasionally 5 in the east later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain soon clearing to become mainly fair, isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the north at first, falling variable 2 to 4 in places, then settling west or southwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, perhaps moderate in the north at first.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
